main.remarks: Represents the certificate-backed verification material selected by a resolver or store for a concrete signature-validation operation.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty access-key signature verification material value.
constructor.returns: Empty access-key signature verification material value.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create access-key signature verification material from a certificate using the default thumbprint-based signer identity.
method.param: Certificate supplying the verification identity and RSA public key.
method.returns: Certificate-backed verification material derived from the supplied certificate.

property.name: Certificate
property.summary: Certificate selected for the verification operation.

property.name: SignerKeyID
property.summary: Canonical signer key identifier bytes associated with the verification material.

property.name: SignerKeyIDFormat
property.summary: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier associated with the verification material.

property.name: Thumbprint
property.summary: Normalized certificate thumbprint associated with the verification material.
